name: simpleRAG
description: Creates a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) service that answers questions about your documents. Use its ask() method to query it.

params.name: source
params.description: A file path, directory, URL, or an array of these, to load documents from.

params.name: model
params.description: A chat model from chatModel(), or a struct of chat model settings.

params.name: options
params.description: Struct of settings such as chunkSize, chunkOverlap, splitterType, maxResults, minScore, vectorStore and batchSize.
